title: Principles of Project Management
topics: Bodies of knowledge and process groups
The project manager and professional conduct

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Stakeholder.
o: a matrix that sorts interested parties by how much authority and concern each holds
the tests a product must pass before the client agrees to take it
any person or group affected by, or able to influence, the undertaking
repetitive continuing activity that turns out the same result again and again
items.s: Stakeholder: any person or group affected by, or able to influence, the undertaking. The other options describe Acceptance criteria, Operations, Power-interest grid.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Quality?
o: the degree to which the output satisfies the stated needs
one short repeated cycle in which a small usable increment is built and reviewed
the formal right to give orders that comes with a position in the hierarchy
an element that must go right for the whole effort to be judged a win
items.s: Quality: the degree to which the output satisfies the stated needs. The other options describe Iteration, Critical success factor, Line authority.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Benefits realisation?
o: the organised set of standards, terms and practices recognised by a professional association
a group of senior managers who meet regularly to review and direct the effort
the later process of confirming that the expected gains actually appear
the number of subordinates whom one manager directly supervises
items.s: Benefits realisation: the later process of confirming that the expected gains actually appear. The other options describe Steering committee, Span of control, Body of knowledge.

items.q: Functional organisation may be defined as
o: repetitive continuing activity that turns out the same result again and again
entrusting defined tasks and the power to decide them while keeping final answerability
winning commitment by setting direction and inspiring others to follow it
a structure in which staff sit in permanent departments and take direction from department heads
items.s: Functional organisation: a structure in which staff sit in permanent departments and take direction from department heads. The other options describe Operations, Leadership, Delegation.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Power-interest grid?
o: a matrix that sorts interested parties by how much authority and concern each holds
a setting where the assigned lead holds most of the authority over borrowed staff
the tangible thing produced, as distinct from the change it is expected to cause
bargaining to reach an agreement that both sides can live with
items.s: Power-interest grid: a matrix that sorts interested parties by how much authority and concern each holds. The other options describe Negotiation, Output, Strong matrix.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Management plan?
o: a log listing each interested party with their concerns, influence and preferred contact
referring a problem upward to a level with authority to settle it
the whole collection of undertakings and grouped efforts that an organisation carries at one time
the master document describing how the effort will be run, watched and closed
items.s: Management plan: the master document describing how the effort will be run, watched and closed. The other options describe Stakeholder register, Escalation, Portfolio.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Change request?

the net worth an organisation gains from the results, whether financial or otherwise
a formal appeal to alter scope, timetable or approved expenditure
items.s: Change request: a formal appeal to alter scope, timetable or approved expenditure. The other options describe Quality, Business value, Acceptance criteria.

the formal right to give orders that comes with a position in the hierarchy
a structure of self-contained teams that report to their own leads rather than to departments
items.s: RACI chart: a table that names who does each task, who answers for it, and who is only consulted. The other options describe Strong matrix, Projectised organisation, Line authority.
